## What’s new in Pär v0.1.9-beta.2026101103

### Added

- Local financial workflows accept HTML templates and fillable PDF text-field
  templates, with verified-source variable bindings and document previews.
- HTML export retains the template structure; PDF export supports print-oriented
  HTML/CSS or preserves uploaded PDF form pages with legible field fitting.
- Missing bindings, unsafe resources, active content and PDF field overflow are
  rejected before plan lock. Static PDFs without named fields are not supported.

### Fixed

- Financial totals and approval summaries use only the locked source scope.
- Concurrent workflow checkpoint and vault operations no longer contend during
  integrity-stamp flushing.
- Workflow forms stack on mobile, and input pickers include PDF statements.
